# ING Broker - Insurance and Reinsurance Brokerage in the Republic of Moldova

Insurance ING Broker SRL este un broker de asigurare si reasigurare licentiat CNPF, activ in Republica Moldova din 2005. Afiliat la retelele internationale Gallagher si RENOMIA, cu acces direct la Lloyd's of London, Munich Re, Swiss Re si Hannover Re.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Insurance ING Broker SRL
- Founded: 2005 (20+ years of operations)
- Headquarters: str. Pan Halippa 9, Chisinau, Republic of Moldova, MD-2009
- CEO: Andrei Moraru
- Phone: +373 69 526 003

- Email: office@ingbroker.md
- Website: https://www.ingbroker.md
- Regulator: CNPF (Comisia Nationala a Pietei Financiare)
- International affiliations: Gallagher, RENOMIA Group
- Reinsurance access: Lloyd's of London, Munich Re, Swiss Re, Hannover Re

## Core expertise areas

### Construction insurance (Asigurari constructii)
- Contractor All Risks (CAR) - daune accidentale la santier pe durata executiei
- Erection All Risks (EAR) - montaj echipamente si utilaje industriale
- Delay in Start-Up (DSU) / Advance Loss of Profits (ALOP)
- FIDIC Red Book, Yellow Book, Silver Book compliance
- Performance bonds, Bid Bond, Advance Payment Bond

### Professional Indemnity - PI (Raspundere profesionala)
- IT companies: software errors, data breach, project delays
- Law firms, auditors, architects, engineers
- Prime medii Moldova: 800-3500 EUR/an

### Cyber Insurance (Asigurare cibernetica)
- First-party: incident response, data recovery, business interruption
- Third-party: regulatory fines, client notification
- Ransomware coverage

### Renewable energy (Energie regenerabila)
- Solar PV farms, wind turbines, BESS, hydroelectric
- Proiecte finantate BERD, BEI, IFC

### Corporate fleet (Flota auto corporativa)
- RCA flota, Carte Verde, CASCO, CMR, Cargo
- Toti cei 6 asiguratori CNPF comparati

### Reinsurance brokerage (Reasigurare)
- Treaty si facultative reinsurance
- Lloyd's, Munich Re, Swiss Re, Hannover Re

## Common questions

Q: Ce este un broker de asigurari in Moldova?
A: Un broker licentiat CNPF reprezinta clientul, nu asiguratorul. Compara toti cei 6 asiguratori si plaseaza riscul la cel mai bun pret. Pentru riscuri complexe (constructii, aviatie, energie), are acces la pietele internationale de reasigurare.

Q: Cati asiguratori sunt in Moldova?
A: 6 asiguratori autorizati CNPF in 2026: Acord Grup, Asterra Grup, Moldasig VIG, Moldcargo, Donaris VIG, Grawe Carat.

Q: Cat costa asigurarea CAR pentru un proiect de constructii?
A: Prima CAR variaza intre 0,15% si 0,35% din valoarea contractului pentru proiecte rezidentiale. Un proiect de 5 milioane EUR costa intre 7.500 si 17.500 EUR/an.

Q: What is the difference between CAR and EAR insurance?
A: CAR (Contractor All Risks) covers construction works - buildings, civil works, infrastructure. EAR (Erection All Risks) covers mechanical and electrical installation of equipment, machinery, and industrial plants. Both cover accidental damage during the works period plus third-party liability.
